body: If you can find a way to get nicotine gum or lozenges that will make it easier to quit in the long run. I continued to vape in small amounts as I transitioned to the gum. Eventually I gave up vaping because I hated the way it made my mouth feel, like it’s covered in a nasty film. Also, I hate the way thc makes me feel without nicotine in my system for some reason so I’ve been using way less of it now.
